_comment: Expected cells of `verify.py demo` (specs/demo-environment DE-D11, DR9): one entry per language x cell.
Values: pass | xfail:<task> (an open task in an active tasks.md; tools/spec_lint.py xfail-task rule) | n/a:<reason>.
xfail and n/a are strict: a passing xfail cell is XPASS and data on an n/a cell is UNEXPECTED; both fail the run.
Predictions from the design 'Expected-results matrix' (r3.5, 2026-11-16); DE6 replaces each with the measured cell.
The .NET gRPC-client exemplar (parked item, b572e3a) is not read: check b reads server, DB and demo series only.
also_xfail lists further open tasks a cell needs before it can pass (checked by spec_lint like the primary task).
b.db_client accepts an exemplar on any span of its trace until A43 is decided (Go, .NET exemplars sit on the parent span).
reason: an xfail cell is XFAIL only when every observed problem contains one of these substrings; any other problem makes it FAIL (DE-D11 r3.7).
requires_series: an n/a cell that is NA only while the metric series exist (Node.js: metrics without SDK exemplars).

b.db_client.ref: design Metric map: contrib SQLAlchemy has no operation duration (unmeasured, DE6 confirms)

b.rpc_server.ref: README.md:312 (Node.js gRPC: no RPC metrics); measured DE6 2026-11-17: series absent
